release: PATCH on 6.1.3, found by driving the app UI. Seven checks ran clean and emitted NO ROW, because a row for a clean check is only produced when the check has a PASS_LABEL and these seven never had one: seo-hreflang, seo-index, seo-content, stb-dup-id, stb-dom, stb-form, stb-uri. The consequence was user-visible false data on the Content & SEO card, which maps rows to cards and therefore printed NOT RUN. Measured on a real report: coverage recorded seo-index and seo-hreflang as verified true, attempted 92, errored 0, and their rules were DECLARED EVALUATED so the score banked them - while the screen told the operator they had not run. The declaration and the screen disagreed and the screen was wrong. Same defect the 2.5.0 note records fixing for the other eight SEO checks; these are the ones left behind because they had no label to begin with. Labels were added only after proving each check PROVABLY RUNS - verified across the stored corpus, all seven verified true with attempted above zero and errored zero in 35-37 of 61 runs - which is the bar this file sets after a label once printed a green tick for a check that could never emit one.
